newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures close lower after tender result.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures close lower after tender result.

text.p: UK grain futures closed sharply lower following the result of the EU weekly grain tender on Thursday.
Traders said the result was disappointing with most people expecting the EU to grant licences for 200,000 to 250,000 tonnes of free market soft wheat.
The Commission granted licences for 133,350 tonnes at 5.99 ecus refund.
The barley result was also a let-down, traders said.
"I don't know how much barley people were expecting, but 5,000 tonnes does seem like a bad joke," said another trader.
UK wheat futures closed 0.70 to 1.40 stg down after trading 336 lots while barley was 0.90 stg lower on 65 lots.
Amsterdam milling wheat futures were again neglected.
On the UK cash market spot feed wheat traded at 106 stg a tonne fob east coast ports.
Delivered trade was again quiet with traders reporting only a few loads changing hands.
